work.title: Real products, built from end to end.
work.body: A selection of products I have shaped, designed, built and taken to production. Open any project to learn about the challenge and my contribution.

intro.title:
From an idea or problem
to a real digital product.
intro.body: I work directly with founders and teams to define, design and build MVPs, platforms and web tools from scratch, from strategy through launch.

about.title: An independent studio. One owner from start to finish.
about.paragraphOne: I’m Bas Bravo, a product designer and developer. Basezero is my independent studio: I work directly with you to understand the problem, refine the idea and turn it into a production-ready solution. I own the complete journey, from strategy and experience through technology and launch.
about.paragraphTwo: I integrate AI throughout exploration, design, development, testing and product evolution. Moving fast is not enough: my experience brings the judgment needed to decide what to build, what to leave out and how to create a solid foundation without unnecessary complexity.
about.paragraphThree: I work best with founders and teams who have a clear idea—or a specific problem—trust an open process and take part in the decisions. The goal is to put a useful first version in front of real people early and learn from it.

services.label: How I can help
services.title: When you need to turn direction into product.
services.body: Engagements focused on creating a useful first version or evolving a foundation that has already proved its value.

launch.title: Launch a product from scratch
launch.body: We define the scope and I turn it into a functional, integrated MVP that is ready to validate.

transform.title: Turn a process into a tool
transform.body: I design a platform or application that simplifies an operation and fits the team’s real workflow.

evolve.title: Evolve an MVP
evolve.body: I review product, experience and technology to prepare the next stage without rebuilding more than necessary.

farewell.title: Let’s talk about what you want to build.
farewell.body: Tell me what you want to achieve, where the project stands and whether you have a target date. I’ll reply personally so we can decide if we are a good fit.

understand.title: Define the challenge
understand.body: Together we define the objective, context, users and constraints to establish a shared framework for product decisions.

shape.title: Design the direction
shape.body: I turn that framework into a product proposal: scope, architecture, experience and visual identity, with explicit priorities.

launch.title: Build the product
launch.body: I design and develop a functional, integrated and deployed first version so decisions can be validated against a real product.

learn.title: Validate with evidence
learn.body: We validate the solution with the business and its users. What we learn becomes concrete decisions and priorities for the next iteration.

grow.title: Evolve with purpose
grow.body: We improve a solid foundation, applying design, technology and AI where they add value while avoiding unnecessary complexity.
